line_basis: All file:line values refer to the frozen 222b1e7 export. On forge_merge HEAD, app/modules/f2w_agent/api.py has +6 lines after line 140 (batch_id field) and further small shifts; route decorator lines move accordingly. Route 'line' is the handler def line, matching f2w_http_routes.json.

classes.public-safe: No source text beyond identifiers and bibliographic metadata, or no source-derived content at all. May be returned to any caller the profile allows.
classes.quote-bounded: May carry derived results or relevant bounded exact quotations with attribution. Allowed on the public surface only through the disclosure projection (exactness, locator, per-response and per-session bounds).
classes.internal-only: Agent/job/trace state, local paths, raw errors or private evidence payloads. Never on the browser/API/SSE/FORGE surface; may be kept in protected stores.
classes.source-serving: Returns raw source material (PDF bytes, page text, chunk text, full prompts containing them) to the caller. Not allowed on any user-facing surface under D19.

method: Read baseline source; measured tracked storage/kg and storage/terminology JSON with stdlib json; checked 300 random context_snippets against local PDF page text (PyMuPDF from the baseline venv, whitespace-normalized substring match). No server was started and no network was used. Scripts: docs/migration/disclosure/evidence/ (build_field_map.py, snip_check.py, coverage.py).

GN.id_label_type.currently_returns: Node id, term name, category, graph id/label.

GN.description.currently_returns: MatKG: raw description|definition|code_description (LLM-written term definition). Tiled: title+description+identity props joined (tiled_graph.py:645-656).
GN.description.size_bound: none in code; tracked KGs max 530 chars (measured)
GN.description.reconstruction_risk: low per node; whole-graph enumeration via GET /graph returns every description. Verbatim-ness of definitions not verified.
GN.description.notes: Rendered as the citation popover snippet (ui/src/app/components/kgCitations.ts:548).

GN.publications.currently_returns: Bibliographic records: source_paper filename, title, authors, DOI, journal, pages, keywords, abstract_text.
GN.publications.size_bound: none on abstract_text in this path (candidate path truncates, see CR.publications)
GN.publications.reconstruction_risk: none for paper body; abstract is publisher text shown whole
GN.publications.notes: Tracked KGs contain 0 abstract_text values (measured); OpenAlex abstracts enter via download candidates.

GN.source_papers.currently_returns: PDF filenames / DOIs (e.g. DOI-derived filenames, local names XRAY1). Not URLs, not paths.

GN.code_snippet.currently_returns: Verbatim code text of CodeSnippet nodes (extracted from paper pages or source repos). Only when include_code=True: graph_node_from_file and graph_subset_from_file.
GN.code_snippet.size_bound: none in code; tracked KGs: 30 code nodes, max 859 chars (measured)
GN.code_snippet.reconstruction_risk: low (short listings); code transcribed from a paper is exact source text
GN.code_snippet.notes: Code from repos carries repo/commit/line provenance; code from papers carries paper+page only.

GN.properties.currently_returns: MatKG property list passthrough, or the entire Tiled/Splash entity properties dict except haystack/outgoingLinks/relations.
GN.properties.size_bound: none; tracked KGs max 3633 chars per property entry (measured)
GN.properties.reconstruction_risk: CONDITIONAL HIGH: the dict path forwards every stored property. Splash import stores all non-core thing fields as properties (splash_links/scripts/import_kg.py:42-58), so context_snippets would pass through for any Tiled/Splash node imported from a MatKG JSON.
GN.properties.notes: Live Tiled holds experiment identity entities today (tiled_graph.py:1-19,44), so no paper text observed on this path at baseline.

GN.extra_fields.currently_returns: All non-core raw keys: strings cut at 800 chars + ellipsis, lists <=24 items, dicts <=16 keys (inner values unbounded), plus identity keys.
GN.extra_fields.size_bound: 800 chars per string; nested values unbounded
GN.extra_fields.reconstruction_risk: low; context_snippets is a core key and excluded (api.py:598). Tracked KGs only carry raw_category here (measured).
GN.extra_fields.notes: Any new passthrough slot (json2kg.py:61-73 copies unknown term keys) lands here automatically.

GN.repo_provenance.notes: source_file_path is a repository-relative path, not a local storage path.

GE.edge.notes: Edge has_evidence (json2kg.py:405-411) is NOT projected; it stays internal. Tracked KGs carry 0 has_evidence values (measured).

GP.source_path.currently_returns: Absolute filesystem path of the graph JSON (or tiled://graphql).
GP.source_path.notes: CONTENT_ACCESS_POLICY s1: no storage paths in user output.

CR.status_flags.currently_returns: Status literal, flags, node ids, turn id.
CR.status_flags.notes: turn_id doubles as the only key needed to fetch the trace (GET /traces/{turn_id}).

CR.answer.currently_returns: LLM answer grounded in KG context, optional hybrid literature/ops chunks (source_rag) and, for active-paper questions, eligible PDF page text. Citations [KG:..]/[PDF: f p.N]/[OPS:..].
CR.answer.reconstruction_risk: MEDIUM [inferred]: no exact-quote verification and no output constraint; repeated prompts can ask the model to repeat supplied context. Only citation format/page eligibility is validated (paper_evidence_agent.py:83-120).

CR.publications.currently_returns: Selected-node publications (as GN.publications) or candidate publication with abstract_text cut to 1600 chars.
CR.publications.size_bound: abstract_text 1600 chars on candidate path; unbounded on KG path

CR.rounds.currently_returns: Raw per-round internal state: retrieval verdict (answer, selected_hits id/label/score, hybrid_rag counts, live_tiled/materials_project meta, error str(exc)), download result, pending_pdfs names, extraction result (output_file path, page counts), kg rebuild, splash reimport, reload, candidate_search with full candidate dicts (OpenAlex abstract untruncated), debate summary, paper_evidence result, extraction_report.
CR.rounds.reconstruction_risk: low for paper body (no chunk text observed in verdicts: retrieval_agent.py:1244-1252 keeps counts only); abstracts and raw error strings are forwarded whole
CR.rounds.notes: Forwards internal job/tool state to the browser and SSE; policy s1 row 'Job/checkpoint/tool/trace payloads' requires sanitizing.

CR.pending.currently_returns: Pending download/extraction card: title, DOI, year, abstract cut to 600 chars, score, repository, downloaded source_paper filename.

CR.orchestration.reconstruction_risk: none [inferred: reason is model text about the question, not source text]

SSE.progress.currently_returns: Progress phases; graph_update carries graph={nodes,edges} built from GraphNode dicts with include_code=True; candidate titles; extraction counts; missing_topics.

SSE.complete.currently_returns: Full ChatResponse JSON (includes rounds and workdir).

SSE.error.currently_returns: Either ChatResponse with *_error status or {status:'stream_error', message:str(exc)}.
SSE.error.reconstruction_risk: low; raw exception text may include paths or provider messages

TR.merged_context.currently_returns: Exact prompt context: KG context plus hybrid literature/ops paper chunks (1200-char chunk text, packed into a 6000-char source budget) and Materials Project context.
TR.merged_context.size_bound: hybrid source budget 6000 chars + KG context budget
TR.merged_context.reconstruction_risk: HIGH: verbatim paper chunks; repeated questions enumerate different chunks

TR.llm_messages.currently_returns: Every rendered prompt: retrieval judge/leeway prompts with merged context; paper-evidence prompts with eligible PDF page text (up to 8 pages x 7000 chars in full mode; every selected page x 7000 chars in targeted mode, where selection follows targeted_max_pages 1..100) and a repair prompt that repeats the same pages.
TR.llm_messages.reconstruction_risk: HIGH: one paper-evidence turn can carry most of a paper's text; a few turns can carry all of it
TR.llm_messages.notes: Extraction prompts are probably not captured: ExtractorAgent runs in run_in_executor without bind_context (extractor_agent.py:106-107) [inferred; confirm with a runtime trace].

TR.llm_response.reconstruction_risk: MEDIUM: raw outputs may repeat context verbatim

TR.request.currently_returns: The caller's own messages and settings.
TR.request.notes: Readable by any caller who knows the turn id: cross-user exposure on a shared deployment.

TR.env.currently_returns: F2W_*/KG_RAG_* environment values with secret-named keys redacted; graph file paths and SHA-256.

TR.response.currently_returns: Answer, parsed citations, publications, pending, status.

ST.paths.currently_returns: Graph file paths under storage/kg and uploads; configured Tiled URI.

ST.tiled_error.currently_returns: Probe/lookup error text with the Tiled key value redacted.

ERR.detail.currently_returns: Raw exception text (FileNotFoundError/ValueError/any Exception) returned as 400/404/502 detail.
ERR.detail.reconstruction_risk: low; may include local paths, Splash/Tiled responses

browser_rendering.what: Citation popover snippet = node.description or publication abstract_text
Publication links: doi.org / arXiv / Semantic Scholar search; no local PDF link
Graph node card: description, publications, code snippets, properties, extra fields; edit form

findings.summary: GET /traces/{turn_id} returns full prompts containing PDF page text and paper chunks to any caller who has a turn id; no auth.
Tracked KG/terminology JSON holds ~127k/141k verbatim context snippets; their union reproduces a median 31% (max 48%) of each paper's text, in public Git.
Full publisher PDFs are in public Git history (H0 E1).
Model-compatible proxy injects query-positioned 1000-char PDF text windows into prompts and returns unconstrained model output; binds 0.0.0.0 without auth.
ChatResponse.rounds and SSE complete/error forward raw internal state, untruncated OpenAlex abstracts, local paths and str(exc).
GraphNode.properties forwards every stored property for dict-shaped (Tiled/Splash) nodes; a literature import that keeps context_snippets in properties would serve them.
No route serves PDF bytes. No route returns a parsed section or crop. Paper Finder never fetches PDFs.
No exact-quote verification exists anywhere: answers, graph descriptions and code snippets are labelled by citation only.
